fact: The National Bureau of Statistics of South Sudan's Laws & Policies page lists the National Bureau of Statistics Act, 2024 as the principal legislation establishing the Bureau and defining its mandate, functions and authority; the page is undated, so its capture date 2026-08-29 is the published date, and the year 2024 is the Act's.

Eye Radio reports that the Vice President's Office deputy press secretary named the National Bureau of Statistics Act 2024 as one of two key documents the Bureau's Director General raised in a briefing on 2025-09-15/16; the report gives no date for the Act's making and the briefing is not an act under it.
